mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, main_id, shop_id, shop_name, month, value, metrics, staff_id, staff_name, rate
mapper.select: SELECT tps.id, tps.main_id, ty.year, ty.dept_name, tps.staff_id, tps.staff_name, tps.month, tps.value, tps.metrics FROM bi_target_new_product_setting tps LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tps.main_id=ty.id AND ty.is_deleted=false WHERE tps.is_deleted=false AND ty.year=#{year} AND ty.dept_id=#{deptId}
